describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile on a plain off-white background. Its body is stocky and entirely covered in dense, shaggy fur that is dark brown on the back and limbs and paler tan-cream on the muzzle, chest and underside. The head is broad and bear-like with a blunt snout, small dark eyes, and two small rounded ears on top. A single thick, black, upcurved horn projects from the top of the nose. The entire dorsal side from just behind the neck to the rump is covered by a very large, highly glossy, dark reddish-brown domed shell with a smooth reflective surface and faint longitudinal ridges; it is divided into a smaller anterior shield over the shoulders and a larger posterior dome. The lower margin of the posterior dome is flared and fringed with small rectangular plates. The animal stands on four thick, heavily furred legs ending in broad clawed paws, and a very small furry tail is just visible beneath the rear edge of the shell.
